The text clearly provides a single-number final estimate at the very beginning: 153,750,000

This number is then justified through a Fermi calculation (123,000 giraffes × 1,250 spots/giraffe = 153,750,000 spots), and the model commits to this as their point estimate without any further revision or hedging that would suggest this isn't their final answer.

<final_estimate>153750000</final_estimate>
